source_specific_conventions.headings: Use # for the source chapter, ## for each actual section, ### for numbered topics or source supplements, and #### for subdivisions; retain Japanese source titles.
source_specific_conventions.locators: Keep physical CS:NNN IDs separate from Part A/Part B printed labels; section locators may share one physical page only inside its single batch owner.
source_specific_conventions.tables_and_callouts: Preserve every comparison row, definition table, shaded source note, condition, exception and useful disclosure classification as a Markdown table or faithful prose.
source_specific_conventions.diagrams: Represent essential table/diagram relationships, applicable standards and reporting-scope meaning in text/tables; do not invent or publish raw figure media.
source_specific_conventions.part_boundaries: Keep Part A chapter keys A01-A31 separate from Part B chapter keys B01-B40; do not align Part B questions to textbook chapter numbers.
source_specific_conventions.question_layouts: Preserve Part B question IDs, rank labels, statements, verdicts, explanations, supplemental notes and false-proposition labels together; theory Part A has no question-answer pair in this pilot.
source_specific_conventions.exclusions: No page inside CS:008-CS:013 or CS:208-CS:209 is excluded; pages outside these two selected batches remain outside this issue.
